title: HSE
summary: A personal repository of coursework notebooks and Docker exercises for a Data Engineer Master's degree program, spanning PySpark, SQL, and Python homework assignments. One notebook (HW_10) uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with a Metadata object to fit synthetic tabular data and evaluate it via run_diagnostic and evaluate_quality.
evidence: Python/HW_10.ipynb:696 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)' with prior Metadata.detect_from_dataframe and evaluate_quality import
